 *Davenburg, Stormwind Harbor*

The gulls were louder than the cannons today.

Strange what a harbor sounds like when it is not preparing for war. Stormwind’s docks are busy, but not disciplined — sailors shouting over merchants, soldiers walking without formation, laughter where orders should be. And yet… Davenburg stands apart from it all. Kul Tiran colors against foreign stone. A reminder that we are guests here, never subjects.

The promotion was brief. No parade. No cheering ranks.

Just witnesses.

That felt right.

A Kul Tiran rank should not be earned in comfort.

I was addressed not as a dock officer, nor merely as watch captain, but as one entrusted to stand where our homeland does not. The Vice Admiral’s representatives made clear what the location itself implied — service here is not guarding walls, it is guarding reputation.

Stormwind watches us.
We watch them back.

I have led patrols before. I have held discipline among sailors and recruits. But this post carries a different weight. Every word spoken in uniform reflects the Admiralty. Every alliance formed risks dishonor if given carelessly. We are not Theramore — we do not forget what was done to our Lord Admiral — yet neither do we sail blind into isolation.

Balance is a harder duty than battle.

I accepted the charge.

If I am to command beyond our shores, then I will ensure any who meet a Kul Tiran officer leave with no doubt:
Our nation endures, and its memory is not softened by distance.

— *[L. Blackwood](https://discord.com/channels/1257431886393905152/1409970650864554086)*
content_html:
Personal Log — Lorena Blackwood
Davenburg, Stormwind Harbor

The gulls were louder than the cannons today.

Strange what a harbor sounds like when it is not preparing for war. Stormwind’s docks are busy, but not disciplined — sailors shouting over merchants, soldiers walking without formation, laughter where orders should be. And yet… Davenburg stands apart from it all. Kul Tiran colors against foreign stone. A reminder that we are guests here, never subjects.

The promotion was brief. No parade. No cheering ranks.

Just witnesses.

That felt right.

A Kul Tiran rank should not be earned in comfort.

I was addressed not as a dock officer, nor merely as watch captain, but as one entrusted to stand where our homeland does not. The Vice Admiral’s representatives made clear what the location itself implied — service here is not guarding walls, it is guarding reputation.

Stormwind watches us.
We watch them back.

I have led patrols before. I have held discipline among sailors and recruits. But this post carries a different weight. Every word spoken in uniform reflects the Admiralty. Every alliance formed risks dishonor if given carelessly. We are not Theramore — we do not forget what was done to our Lord Admiral — yet neither do we sail blind into isolation.

Balance is a harder duty than battle.

I accepted the charge.

If I am to command beyond our shores, then I will ensure any who meet a Kul Tiran officer leave with no doubt:
Our nation endures, and its memory is not softened by distance.

— L. Blackwood

author: Thuras
subject: The Chronicle of Thuras Ravenwood - Part 1
content_md:
Greetings traveler and welcome to my memoirs,

A chronicle of a man trying to find his purpose and destiny within Azeroth.
My name is ***Thuras Ravenwood*** , son of ***Valentine Ravenwood*** and ***Narcissa Ravenwood***, Gilnean nobles originally from Ravenshire. I was born in the year 598 by the Kings Calendar, a little after the Second War begun, in the capital city of Gilneas.

During my childhood, my parents were mostly absent, either being busy with the war or forging and disbanding alliances or either being sent on envoys, I was mostly myself and the butler ***Gregas***. While ***Gregas*** appeared like a normal frail old gilnean, he was much more than that, he was an ex combatant in the gilnean army, with extensive knowledge of most weapons and even some spells. He taught me everything I know, how to stand my ground and how to fight for the people and protect the weak.
With the severing of the alliance kingdoms and my family becoming more and more isolationist in ideology, I decided to abandon my home and register with the paladin order "**The Knigts of the Silver Hand**".

![Image](https://i.pinimg.com/474x/a5/65/69/a565699d4d29a256211f216a6fabdb3d.jpg)

I joined their ranks under the guidance ***Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker***, being of nobility born had its privileges I guess. I have decided that my values and ideas align with that of the order, but little did I know that the darkness can corrupt even those who are bathed in light.
I was only a young lad when I saw the culling of those poor souls in Stratholme, the fall of Lordaeron, the dismantling of everything I thought I should stand for.
Needless to say everything was a shock and I had to seek refuge in where I knew it was safe, back home.
But that did not go to plan as you might presume...

![Image](https://www.hearthstonetopdecks.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/03/featured-the-witchwood008.jpg)

Coming back to my home felt like entering a new war, one that it was unavoidable. Scourge was everywhere and I couldn't reach the city, I had to hide in the surrounding forests but even there, danger was lurking at every corner.
Dreams started appearing vividly, of creatures of the night, hunting me, devouring me and then ... waking up as one of them. An immortal beast that had an insatiable thirst for conflict and blood.

I shook them of as just dreams, but one evening when I was trying to slip through the woods back into Ravenshire, my nightmares came true. I've encountered one of those beasts, sitting right in front of me, ready to pounce and have my neck.

![Image](https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/8bce5ab6-4b83-4ff0-8831-b4d63e47d991/de6hbz2-473b0b0d-99fa-4865-9c4c-00e7b9389f30.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..sAHDS7BmfbVfIjSZtKat7lJwZGkU-ak817dQM1em59k)

My fate seems to be sealed, but in those panic moments, I remembered my training, my vows to the light, my desire to just stay... alive. I have fought the beast , we fought relentlessly ... in a moment where I thought it is going to be my last, he pounced and bit me on my side , raising me in the air and tossing me into a tree. I have casted my holy light to prevent the injuries killing me straight away, I raised my hammer and shattered the ground beneath him just before he was able to strike me a second time, only to use all my strength left to shatter his back in one swift blow.
I fell on one knee facing the dying beast now, not being far off myself. As he struggled to breathe and move, he locked his eyes with mine and growled, but it was not one of agony. It was a mocking growl, as if he was the one who won the duel.

![Image](https://encrypted-tbn0.gstatic.com/images?q=tbn:ANd9GcSpuy9oSyG9RLmTLxG59vBlunCexkov72ONLw&s)

The last thing I remember was that growl before I feel into a deep slumber, wondering as I was drifting if this is the end for myself. No legacy, no great achievements , not enough great deeds... Is this the end ? ...

**Where?**
  • Warrior’s Terrace, Darnassus!
**When?**
  • Starting at <t:1739023200:F> (Copy this into discord for your time zone!)
**Who?**
  • Alliance or neutral forces that mean no ill will towards the Kaldorei. Please no PVP in the event, and if you RP as an undead please do so in secrecy. We would appreciate no derailing of the event. If you need more info, please see Laws of Darnassus in the Nightsong server to see all laws of Darnassus. You can join the server by clicking the link in my bio!


Astrahe is upon us all as yet another Xallavar passes into the echelons of history. The new year rises along with Elune’s first full zenith, and the Kaldorei celebrate their victory millennia past against the Legion in the War of the Ancients.

While the fallen protector Omen is laid to rest once more outside of Malfurion Stormrage’s Barrow den, his love Tyrande and the Sisterhood of Elune have prepared festivities in Darnassus. However - that isn’t to say Staghelm does not have something in store too! The Sentinel forces of Nightsong have been delegated the task to oversee the event assuring both safety and splendor for all the guests. Join us for…
  • Songs and Stories by Nivekai of the Children of Cenarius, Shyari of the Tranquil Tea Haven, and Roodrid Whispersong of the Turtle Faire!
  • Traditional Tea Ceremonies and sweets by the Tranquil Tea Haven and supporting the Tranquil Tea Haven!
  • Morpho Moonwell Morsels by The Morpho Family supporting the Turtle Faire!
  • Tales Fortold divination services by Ashberry supporting the Turtle Faire!
  • Volatile Explosives alcohol and fireworks by Onivayle Bloombreath (now Boombreath /j)
  • Miriala’s Mystery Mixtures and Fishy Fixtures Sushi and Potions by Miriala Silverbow
  • Kimchi Making with Onivayle Bloombreath !
  • Enchanted Threads by Sharlia supporting the School of the Dragonhawk! Get enchantments, transmog items, and styling tips!
  • Winterspring Wonders by Thero’anir Adir supporting the School of the Dragonhawk by selling gemstones, jewelry, and flowers just in time for Love is in the Air!






Funds made at this event will go towards helping the Tranquil Tea Haven, Turtle Faire, and Dragonhawks to get either guild housing or banks.
  • ⛩ The Nightsong have achieved their housing goals, so we’ve set out to help support smaller guilds in the community as well in a “pay what you will” setting. If you cannot donate gold at the event, you will not be turned away. This event is open to all - but don’t expect to get major enchants from Shalira for free.




🕯 Timeline 🕯
Copy paste this into discord to get a listing of times converted to your standard time for your convenience.

Meditation with Shyari & Kimchi Contest with Onivayle Bloombreath

Fireworks

Closing
<t:1739030400:F>

We recommend downloading these addons for best enjoyment of the events! Pretty Skies will make for better screenshots of fireworks and darker skies at night; HD Textures will make the world look more reflective and full.

author: Tinkershells
subject: Turtle Faire
content_md:
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/yYjLt8gf/turtlefaire.png)
 **The last Saturday of each month!**
 **10 AM CT | 8 AM PDT | 11 AM ET | 3 PM UTC**
ㅤ
Turtle Faire is a monthly, guild-hosted RP community event open to role-players of all levels and both factions! We celebrate creativity, camaraderie, and immersive storytelling through Performances, Stalls, Games & Contests, Storytelling, Food & Drink, and more. Every month, we journey to a new location, so be sure to check in to see where the Faire will pop up next!

ㅤ
---
ㅤ
 **♦ FAIRE ACTIVITIES ♦**

 **Performances**
Enjoy music, poetry, and other performances by talented players.

 **Stalls**
Explore player run stalls showcasing a variety of crafts, goods, services. Even advertise your rp guild!

 **Games and Contests**
Participate in fun games and contests with exciting prizes.

 **Storytelling**
Share your tales or listen to stories from fellow adventurers.

 **Food and Drink**
Sample delicious in-game treats from various food vendors.

 **And More!**
If you have a unique idea or concept for the Faire, reach out so we can work together to make it happen.
ㅤ
---
ㅤ
 **♦ MEET THE CREW ♦**

 **The Tinkershells, Turtle Faire Masters**
Turtlyn and Turtimer Tinkershell are the visionary couple behind Turtle Faire, planning and orchestrating every wondrous detail. They’re an eclectic magical gnome duo with green, turtle-like hues, often seen riding around on their turtles keeping things running smoothly. Their whimsical presence brings a dash of fun and excitement wherever they roam.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/j2r80W41/Screenshot2-287.png)

 **The Faire Loa, Jallah’gah**
Jallah’gah, the Loa of Games and Trials, blends both playful and ominous energies for the Faire. He appears as a tall forest troll in a mysterious, ever-shifting mask, sometimes taking flight in the form of an owl. As the RPGM Fairegrounds constructor, he ensures each venue is filled with wonder.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/VNr4J97T/image5.png)

 **Roodrid Whispersong, Head of Recruitment**
Roodrid is a lovely elf bard and the Faire’s only *live* performer. Recording the Faires so the magic can last forever. Formerly a maiden of the Nightingale Faire, she now helps Turtle Faire flourish by bringing in new faces and enchanting spectators with her voice.
<https://www.twitch.tv/roodrid/>
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/JzTdDzRy/Screenshot-2024-04-17-141940.png)

 **The <Nightsong Sentinels>, Security**
This generous Kaldorei guild provides their finest sentinels to ensure safety and order at the Faire. Their watchful presence allows patrons to enjoy every performance and stall undisturbed. Their dedication to peace and harmony sets the perfect backdrop for all Faire festivities.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/9QfLhHyc/image3.png)

 **Splatricia, Head of Hospitality**
Splatricia is a friendly, mysterious ooze who somehow speaks Common! Always accompanied by her little oozling, Montegoo, she guides Fairegoers around with a bubbly attitude. Her warm welcome ensures everyone has a wonderful experience at the Turtle Faire.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/8C9K4XJN/Screenshot-272.png)

 **Kendrik Zapblast and “Blast’n’Pass”**
Kendrik Zapblast is a goblin engineer with decades of experience in all things explosive. Visit his Blast’n’Pass stall for colorful fireworks, landmines, and more! When he’s not thrilling crowds with pyrotechnics, he’s helping the Tinkershells dazzle the stage with special effects and calling up performances.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/59w753xW/2.png)

 **"The Harvesters" Saerah and Christofor Masseigh**
A wholesome human couple from Westfall who lost their farm to the Defias, but not their spirit. Bringing their love of music to the Faire by performing duet Westfall-folk songs that share their story. Accompanied by their adopted dancing murloc tadpoles, Gurky and Murky, their uplifting songs remind everyone that hope can always shine.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/j5f8F6PN/Screenshot1-258.png)

 **Iridianny and Castaras and "Morpho Moonwell Morsels"**
A mystical elf couple run Morpho Moonwell Morsels, serving up traditional Kaldorei dishes like Strider Stew and Darnassian Bleu. Their passion for sharing Kaldorei culture and flavors welcomes adventurers of all backgrounds. Every bite is hand crafted crafted with care and guidance of Elune.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/jjL3zYjM/Screenshot-283.png)

 **Lady Luciana Cousland, Woodworking Stall**
Lady Luciana Cousland offers handcrafted wooden sculptures, toys, and other artistic creations. All profits go to orphanages across Azeroth. Her dedication to helping others embodies the spirit of the Turtle Faire.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/brkQx84f/imagel.png)

 **Pechuer Mudfinger and “Muddy’s Marvelous Mixes”**
Originally a fishmonger, selling fishy treats, Pechuer shifted to brewing up “fun” in all its forms at Turtle Faire. From fadeleaf brews to Thalassian smoke pipes, there is something for everyone to enjoy. Expect a lively blend of mischief and flavor with every puff or sip.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/ht3p4Z0T/image4.png)

 **Coco, Haunting Songstress**
Coco takes the stage with haunting melodies that weave sorrow and hope into a single, resonant tapestry. Her flowing pink hair and unwavering presence capture hearts, as she sings with an emotion both deeply personal and universally felt. She doesn’t beg for attention—she simply sings, and by doing so, commands it.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/Kvx90Mzk/image.png)

 **Emmoth, Gambling Stall**
Emmoth invites you to test your luck at his gambling stall. Though he normally loathes risks, losing coin is not so terrible as losing one's life. Tricksters beware, the warlock won't take kindly to being swindled. His stall is often accompanied by Fflur, who'll either also gamble or stand guard.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/SNhPHPZK/imageE.png)

 **Rakuul's Exotic Goods**
Rakuul roams every corner of Azeroth in search of the unusual and the extraordinary, packing his Kodo with goods no ordinary vendor could offer. From master-forged blades to forgotten cookbooks and glittering, his stock changes with every adventure. Swing by his booth to haggle, swap tales, and walk away with a treasure that’s truly one-of-a-kind.
![Image](https://i.postimg.cc/B6k7M2Gg/Screenshot-from-2025-05-31-11-30-36.png)

 **![🌷](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f337.svg) 𝔹𝕪𝕝𝕥𝕒𝕟 ![🪺](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1faba.svg)**

 - *Any who have no ill wills or intentions, any who do not engage in corruptive magic (Void, Fel, Undeath, Nightmare), any who did not engage in the killing of Cenarius  or deaths of his children, and any who are willing to lay down arms for the evening (weapons will be taken at the door). If you must come in secret, please ensure that your OC does not cause trouble!*

![🌼](//cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/twitter/twemoji@latest/assets/svg/1f33c.svg) **What to Wear**

Byltan, the ancient Druidic festival enjoyed by the Kaldorei, the Children of Cenarius, the Shu'halo, and all children of nature is nearly here! As spring reaches its zenith and summer approaches, the Druidic races gather in Hyjal to celebrate the rite of spring and coming of summer as life returns to Azeroth.

The sacred creatures of the Kaldorei and Shu’Halo - the Hippogryphs and the Wyverns - hatched in February are to take their first flights at this festival. Many riders will bond with their new Mount this day, and new beginnings are upon us as we take to the soon to be summer skies soaring!

THE HERALDS OF SPRING

Word would travel from Mount Hyjal of the events of Byltan! Shu’Halo, Dryads, and Kaldorei each would win awards for their races during the event - honoring Cenarius, Elune, and the Earth Mother in equal measure.

1. Fastest Frolic!
Lirilune would be the fastest over all in the frolic, ascending to the pinnacle of Mount Hyjal to look down upon the skeleton of Archimonde! Her perseverance as eternal as the Great Tree Nordrassil! Gifted Elunarian Cuffs inlaid with Elunite and Moonstone, her four legs would glimmer with the silver moonlight of Elune at every move.
Arexx would take second, with Tawariell the dryad close behind!

2. Hornlocking!
Kiuna would show that Hornlocking was not just for men! Competing for the honor of the Earth Mother, she would take home a leather Ceremonial Loincloth, blessed on Spirit Rise in Thunderbluff.
Patasha would take second!

3. May Majesties
Castaras & Idrianny Morpho - a lovely couple from the Turtle Faire would be the Heralds of Spring, and allow the Wyverns and Hippogryphs to fly! Crediting Elune as the corner stone of their marriage, they were happy to be blessed and recognized as the most sweet couple of all.

Congratulations to each of our winners! Happy Byltan!

subject: Pocket books: Loer for Noobos
content_md:
> By strength of will that isolated mountains hold legends are forged in flames of hearts and quelled in serene streams of tears.

Welcome There!

Weather you are arriving from a time long ago, never before, ever-after or you stay in a location where time is standing still, and yet, you find yourself willful for an adventure, the threads of fate that belong here ought to suit and help you connect to the WarCraft universe on a deeper level.

 *The mats are copied from <https://warcraft.wiki.gg> and similar repositories. Edited and mingled into one by yours truly. The origins of the blizzard that entertains us while breaking out in cold sweat.*

Anywho that wished to share their tale, please humor me and those who had their eyes enter...

KalimdorBefore after
> In the beginning there was the vessel, there was the thought and there was the spirit. In order to connect the link between the three it was required to learn how to balance each individually. Years and years had passed through and the coming of the unity opened up a way to enter a state of meditation for the beings in question where they became able to reach deep within their souls and bring focus to what laid inside. Memories, joints and muscles let loose and they developed in might as the dark followed the light until they became the absolute power in the realm of reality.
>  By the time of writing this memoire Azeroth got familiar with the dragonkin. Yet, less was known of the titans beforehand. They share a similarity in this potent attribute since them as well carry high aptitude for balance. To further this line of thought, there is a good reason as to why the titans were the foreparents. It is a known dilemma that dragons were created in aspect to themselves during the shaping of our world but there is something they couldn't pass down by any means during the procedure; Soularice. It is tied to cosmic entities. They are able to part from fractures of themselves to invoke greatness and succeed any task that the universe bestows upon them. Even if it would mean the end of existence, they learnt to make the sacrifice over the period of time they matured.
>  Their bodies fused with stone, iron and crystal to withstand nature's course. Then fossilised, to further their individual prowess, each one absorbed minerals into their phisique. Distinctly hidden gems from about untouched parts of the nether to improve the hold over their ruling. All of these had been established by different subterrean matrix beings solely to summon the opportunity to build their bodies from nothing to perfection and eventually over many millennials fill the role that required a touch on the scale of their magnitude.
>  According to legend, Aman'Thul was the first titan to wake from his slumber, he didn't know back then why or how. He was alone in the eternal dark beyond, but understood in his heart that other titans must exist, and so set out to explore the myriad worlds of the universe in search of others of his kind. Over time, he discovered other nascent world-souls, as he named them after watching them grow and nurtured them until they awoke and joined him in his travels. Eventually, the first five became known as the Pantheon, and in the early ages of the great dark they ordered and reshaped countless worlds in hopes of finding other titans.
>  With the passage of time they happened upon their nemesic rivals in the name of gods, the picturesque beings who served many worlds all around the universe as supreme entities. Although their superiority over the living was on par, an item brought conflict among the races. There were those who found it eerie to let go of the differences that rely on the circumstances of their birth. While titankin need to suffer from nature's course until they fully manifest, god kind is born into ambrosia which under examplary circumstances may very well remain in the entirity of their time. In case two of them were to enter a battle planets would suffer their wrath and lightways, stars, eventually a whole world must break apart if the conflict sees no solution. In order to avoid an all out war between the races ever lasting memories were planted into the leading councils' core memories because the colossal clashes that occured in the nether carried such devastation that none wishes to ever reoccur.
>  A battle was fought on the planet in question. Titans came out victorious and subjugated them. They put an end to the selfish desires that corrupted the heart of the residing gods who resembled monsters if anything else by that time. The presence of the old gods would have spread forward if they were to abandon the act and turned reality upside down within this part of the cosmos. Furthermore, the entire planet was radiant with energy, harboring a world-entity that the sister of the Pantheon, Eonar, deep within her tender heart's seclusive secrets wished to raise as her own.
>  Kalimdor, as it used to be known in ages past, had a latent potency that offered accomodation for either a world-entity to bloom into a soul or a god to rest. As we know now, godkin took over the realm in the beginning of this era. For a certain few to choose a partner for this period was ideal but for three of them to join was rare. However, four decided for the same planet, new things to imagination were bound to happen and sparks cought on fire.
>  Old them're called on this land at present and they're marked as old for reason-reasonable. Elders in the gods' society grow weak and shrink in size but like days end they may surface again with the sun's first rays, regenerated to their full strength, grow to further with their agenda. In order for it happen, however, they must find a suitable source of living atmosphere where they are capable to rest their tired selves and gobble it up whole. The event may take as long as an instant but much longer a time as well. On old Kalimdor the time required neared infinity and the land looked like to be subject to excrutiating torture, violent pain and cruelty. Volcanos surfaced in the stench covered area and dark presence overthrew the natural course of the globe's growth.
>  The titans, Sargeras, Khaz'goroth, Norgannon and Aman'Thul carried out a judgement over the fiendish gods that inhabited the continent for the Pantheon's future plans to see sunlight and banished them beneath the earth until time memoriam. They were gods nonetheless! They might had been consuming the world in their lucid daze but as they slept in, many changed, for in order the shadow to exist there must be light as well as we all know it. Thus, they constructed Kalimdor in their nightmares to the better.
>  They had presented volume to the elements which caused the titan-forged curse: flesh. The elements mentioned build the base core of every religion on this earth. Sun and moons developed in age, planet and atmosphere in size for their presence, giving birth to mortal races later on the titan ruled land. Their entrance into the bounds of this section of the universe meant the coming of evil and holy. It unhinged the natural balance of the shapers hence they initiatated to end it. They prolonged the manifestiation for a while! However, elves, trolls and many more have adapted their religions ratherkind in peculiar similarity to the taurahe who are well known to revere fire, air, water and earth. Each in respect of their roles in the whole wide world and as to the present state of the world proves it, the four gods have achieved their agenda from beneath the surface of the earth. The creations of the four gods over the thousands of years, the yearning and prayers of the collaborating races have been slowly but certainly restoring their powers to their full.
>  The monumental stepstone in the beginning of the planetarian history, the birth of the Well of Eternity ignited a series of events that last to this day and as long as fate carries life on the planet, the gods and titans are bound to face one another again. The races of this world would soon have to band together, for they will have to be the ones to quell their confrontation in the coming age.

The turn of tides
> The original Well of Eternity was formed from a great wound in Azeroth's surface, created when Aman'Thul, the Highfather of the titan Pantheon, ripped the god Y'Shaarj from the world's crust and tore it apart. The volatile arcane lifeblood of Azeroth's world-entity rushed to the surface and roiled over the world. It was through this event that the Pantheon realized that the old gods had embedded themselves too deep in the planet's surface to remove without severely harming the world, and so they instead resolved to imprison the vile entities below the surface of the world. After the gods and their elemental minions had been defeated and sealed in their prisons, the titans' most powerful servants, the keepers, set to work to seal the still-bleeding wound. After having labored day and night to construct magic wards around the wound, the tumultuous arcane energies eventually calmed and settled into balance, and the keepers named it the "Well of Eternity".The enormous lake became the source and true heart of the world's arcane magic and natural power. Drawing its energies from the infinite dark beyond, the well acted as a mystical fount, sending its potent energies out across the world to nourish life in all its wondrous forms.
>  Many thousands of years back to the orcs and humans, ancient Kalimdor was the domain of the large Kaldorei Empire led by Queen Azshara. She ruled from the capital city of Zin with her loyal followers known as the highborne who were the highest-ranking caste of night elf nobility. These privileged nobles became obsessed with the Well of Eternity and abused its arcane magics until their activities caught the attention of Sargeras.
>  The watchful titan got lost in his reasoning. On the course of the path of righteousness since the ordering of the planet, he kept moving on while the opposing ends drew him back, ever near.
>  This land and him share a deep bond. He promised the queen that he would remake the world into an arcane paradise, and that they would be rewarded with great power for serving him. Frivioulos to the potent opportunity, at his command, the highborne created a portal using the well's energies in order to allow entrance to the planet. Thus, the first invasion of the Burning Legion began. Demons poured from the queen's jeweled palace and laid waste to most of the city. Death and devastation followed the demonic army as it spread outward. The ensuing war, The War of the Ancients consequently turned out to rain terror instead of what he had promised.
>  The two key figures in the war, Illidan and his twin brother Malfurion Stormrage were born at Lorlathil in Val'sharah and grew up in Suramar as friends with Tyrande who learnt to become a priestess. Their parents died years before the coming war. They were forced to figure out life on their own. In his youth, he attempted to master the druidic forces, as his brother had, but the sorcery called to him in a way that the magic of the land did not. He also desired to impress the girl. He often acted without thinking; never realizing that these displays weren't quite what the priestess was looking for in a mate but while Illidan struggled to win her heart, they both failed to realize that the battle was already over, way before it had begun; Tyrande longed for Malfurion.
>  Amber eyes were a sign of a great destiny, however, an indication for inherent druidic potential as well but Illidan did not wish to wait until his latent potential manifested.
>  Though not a highborne himself, he became the personal caster of a highborne military leader. When the demon invasion of Kalimdor had begun and Azshara's treachery became known, Malfurion convinced Illidan to leave his queen. He agreed but they soon met an other conflicting dilemma when his brother came to understand that their adversaries were too powerful to fall in combat, to end the invasion, he plotted the destruction of the Well of Eternity.
>  The idea was appalling, most certainly. The well was the source of their magic and the elves' immortality according to many and in the eye of a magician its loss was a price far too dear to pay.
>  Whereas the night elves struggled to maintain their ground, the number of demons did not seem to permanently diminish. As the war continued, Illidan gained rank within the defenders and became the leader of the wizards of the Moon Guard. However, he ordered them to transfer their power into him instead of utilising their individual powers. Thus empowering his own spells instead; but in doing so, this opened them to attack from the demons with no means to defend themselves. After one particular battle, he drained his own soldiers to the point that they could not resist to die by his hands. With sacrifice, he managed to counter the enemies.
>  Xavius, the cunning, closest advisor of Azshara, conjured a spell at this point that aimed Illidan personally. Held knowledge of the conflict between the brothers for Whisperwind's love and used his power to darken his thoughts further, convincing him that if Malfurion were to die, he would no longer have a rival for her heart. After the spell took effect, the sight of Tyrande in the arms of his brother on a fateful day shattered his ties to the kaldorei defenders.
>  Carrying the scar, he yet with a courageous plan, journeyed to Zin and feigned allegiance to Azshara in order to save their people. He plotted to bring forth the world's guardian aspects' power, "the dragon soul", in order to close the portal; begging the question; why weren't the dragons present and was the elven race acting as the first line of defense against such potent enemy.
>  To achieve this, he had to gain more power. Past a given time of servitude, he was eventually brought before Sargeras, who's expertiese lead to the discovery that the night elf carried a secret. Illidan was bound to act on spot but his wit managed to outmanouver his. He behaved as if he wanted to obtain their power for the legion in exchange to gain even more potent powers for himself once the deed is done.
>  Once the explanation he had given took effect the Dark Titan scorched his eyes out and set orbs of mystic fire in their place, which allowed him to see all forms of magic and the terror of a vision that explored the true strength of the legion and their crusade across infinite worlds. Then and there, he understood; shutting the portal wouldn't mean the end to their crusade.
>  The coming of the draconic powers within their hands ought to enhance the strength in the link of their portal that connected the two realms to the point where Sargeras himself could have passed through. However, reuniting with the kaldorei resistance, which now greatly mistrusted him after seeming to hand over the key to victory to the demons, together, brothers back to back, they put up a surprising defense, and managed to close the portal.
>  The surplus magical stress was too great for the fount which imploded with disastrous consequences. As if struck by a giant hammer, the well was driven downwards by the impact and collapsed in on itself until it was finally obliterated, piercing the planet's molten core, and creating a raging maelstrom.
>  During the destruction wrought by the sundering, the queen and her loyalists gathered at her palace as the waters swallowed them into fathomless depths. Azshara managed to make a pact with the water god N'Zoth, swearing allegiance to it in order for their survival. As soon as she agreed, the first Naga was born. A cursed and warped scaly, serptentine, underwater creature. Her loyal servants transformed with her and their hearts became as black as the deepest ocean trenches, and hate enveloped their thoughts.
>  Hidden from the world, they would quietly build their new empire in the cold darkness at the bottom of the sea, beneath the swirling waters of the maelstrom. Azshara herself expanded with hate and rage, becoming a massive monstrosity, reflecting the wickedness and malice that had always hidden within her core. With patience and cunning, they began spreading their dominion over the oceans. They would rebuild their power and it would take over ten thousand years before the naga would reveal their existence to the surface world.

Mount Hyjal
> The few night elves that survived the horrific explosion rallied together on crudely made rafts and slowly made their way to the only landmass in sight. Somehow, by the grace of Elune, Malfurion, Tyrande, and Cenarius had survived the Great Sundering. The weary heroes agreed to lead their fellow survivors and establish a new home for their people.
>  As they journeyed in silence, they surveyed the wreckage of their world and realized that their passions had wrought the destruction all around them. Though Sargeras and his Legion had been ripped from the world by the Well's destruction, Malfurion and his companions were left to ponder the terrible cost of victory.
>  There were many Highborne who did survive the cataclysm unscathed. They made their way to the shores of the new land along with the other night elves. Though Malfurion mistrusted the Highborne's motivations, he was satisfied that they could cause no real mischief without the Well's energies.
>  As the weary mass of night elves landed upon the shores of the new land, they found that the holy mountain, Hyjal, had survived the catastrophe. Seeking to establish a new home for themselves, Malfurion and the night elves climbed the slopes of Hyjal and reached its windswept summit. As they descended into the wooded bowl, nestled between the mountain's enormous peaks, they found a small, tranquil lake. To their horror, they found that the lake's waters had been fouled by magic.
>  Illidan, having survived the Sundering as well, had reached Hyjal summit long before Malfurion and the night elves. In his mad bid to maintain the flows of magic in the world, Illidan had poured his vials, which contained the precious waters from the Well of Eternity, into the mountain lake.
>  The Well's potent energies quickly ignited and coalesced into a new Well of Eternity. The exultant Illidan, believing that the new Well was a gift to future generations, was shocked when Malfurion hunted him down. Malfurion explained to his brother that magic was innately chaotic and that its use would inevitably lead to widespread corruption and strife. Still, Illidan refused to relinquish his magical powers.
>  Knowing full well where Illidan's ruthless schemes would eventually lead, Malfurion decided to deal with his power-crazed brother once and for all. With Cenarius' help, Malfurion sealed Illidan within a vast underground barrow prison, where he would remain chained and powerless until the end of time. To ensure his brother's containment, Malfurion empowered the young warden, Maiev Shadowsong, to be Illidan's personal jailor.
>  Concerned that destroying the new Well might bring about an even greater catastrophe, the night elves resolved to leave it be. However, Malfurion declared that they would never practice the arts of magic again. Under Cenarius' watchful eye, they began to study the ancient arts of druidism that would enable them to heal the ravaged earth and re-grow their beloved forests at the base of Mount Hyjal.

The World Tree
> For many years, the night elves worked tirelessly to rebuild what they could of their ancient homeland. Leaving their broken temples and roads to be overgrown, they constructed their new homes amidst the verdant trees and shadowed hills at Hyjal's base. In time, the dragons that had survived the great Sundering came forth from their secret abodes.
>  Alexstrasza the red, Ysera the green, and Nozdormu the bronze descended upon the druids' tranquil glades and surveyed the fruits of the night elves' labors. Malfurion, who had become an arch-druid of immense power, greeted the mighty dragons and told them about the creation of the new Well of Eternity.
>  The great dragons were alarmed to hear the dark news and speculated that as long as the Well remained, the Legion might one day return and assault the world once again. Malfurion and the three dragons made a pact to keep the Well safe and ensure that the agents of the Burning Legion would never find their way back into the world.
>  Alexstrasza, the Lifebinder, placed a single, enchanted acorn within the heart of the Well of Eternity. The acorn, activated by the potent, magical waters, sprung to life as a colossal tree. The mighty tree's roots grew from the Well's waters, and its verdant canopy seemed to scrape the roof of the sky.
>  The immense tree would be an everlasting symbol of the night elves' bond with nature, and its life-giving energies would extend out to heal the rest of the world over time. The night elves' gave their World Tree the new name Nordrassil, which meant "crown of the heavens" in their native tongue.
>  Nozdormu, the Timeless, placed an enchantment upon the World Tree to ensure that as long as the colossal tree stood, the night elves would never age or fall prey to sickness or disease.
>  Ysera, the Dreamer, also placed an enchantment upon the World Tree by linking it to her own realm, the ethereal dimension known as the Emerald Dream. The Emerald Dream, a vast, ever-changing spirit world, existed outside the boundaries of the physical world. From the Dream, Ysera regulated the ebb and flow of nature and the evolutionary path of the world itself.
>  The night elf druids, including Malfurion himself, were bound to the Dream through the World Tree. As part of the mystical pact, the druids agreed to sleep for centuries at a time so that their spirits could roam the infinite paths of Ysera's Dreamways. Though the druids were grieved at the prospect of losing so many years of their lives to hibernation, they selflessly agreed to uphold their bargain with Ysera.
